Closes #<issue-number>

## Change
What problem does this solve, and what now works?

## Verification
Commands actually run and results. Relevant invariant IDs.

## Limits / handoff
Unverified behavior, remaining work, ownership or contract changes.

## Before requesting merge
- [ ] Every local commit is pushed, and the PR head SHA matches `git rev-parse HEAD` locally.
- [ ] CI is green on the latest commit, not an earlier one.
- [ ] This description has no "not yet pushed" or other pending notes.
- [ ] The worklog links this PR, and closed issues meet all acceptance criteria.
